name: Honda CB77 Super Hawk
engine: 305 cc air-cooled SOHC parallel twin, two carbs, points ignition
intro: Honda's early 305 twin. Original parts are scarce, so keep and restore what came with the bike.

A: Photograph everything before you take it apart. Many CB77 parts are hard to find now.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
